question: Should `nodes` be accepted as a permanent first-class Code Mode global, rather than leaving paired-node interaction solely in the generic tool catalog?
rationale: This is a new model-facing API and a persistent ergonomics contract; source-level test coverage cannot decide whether that is the desired long-term Code Mode surface.

options.title: Accept the node-handle API
options.body: Approve `nodes` as the supported Code Mode abstraction after real paired-Gateway proof confirms the existing policy path is preserved.

options.title: Keep generic tool discovery
options.body: Decline the new global and retain node interaction through the existing generic tool catalog to avoid another long-lived model-facing API.

recommendation.title: Accept the node-handle API
recommendation.body: Approve `nodes` as the supported Code Mode abstraction after real paired-Gateway proof confirms the existing policy path is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this contributor as the proposer of the Code Mode API and its implementation.
